text: Requirements gathering — functional versus non-functional, the first real question in any design.
A functional requirement is what the system does. A non-functional requirement is how well it has to do it — speed, reliability, cost. Neither one is enough by itself.
A vague prompt like analyze NYC taxi trips doesn't specify anything real yet. Who's it for? How fresh does it need to be? How many trips a day? Every answer leads to a different correct design.
This is exactly where a real SLO's number comes from in the first place. Next up: back-of-the-envelope estimation — turning these requirements into real numbers.
